answer: Proof-of-Path Attestation: each agent identity must carry a verifiable, unique route of prior interactions signed by distinct counterparties, like channels carved through a karst. Registration rejects any route whose interaction graph overlaps heavily with an existing one, forcing attackers to build genuinely separate histories. Building N credible routes costs N times the effort of real repeated coordination, since each fake history needs independent counterparties. A shared garden of honest agents grows dense while fakes stay sparse, and the river of new identities must fork real effort,
